scope.statement: This was documentary consistency checking, not an additional proof or computation.
scope.purpose: Check agreement among the event register, reviewed notes and event records, generated notes, classification decisions, and the recorded work supporting non-background labels; compare arithmetic-slip notes with current page text.

files_inspected.path_basis: Paths below are relative to work_directory.

checks_actually_performed.method: Compared the multiset of statement_id, date, who, type, and outcome tuples in CHECK_EVENTS.tsv with the check_events in all 24 reviewed JSON files.
checks_actually_performed.result: Exact agreement; no event tuple appeared on only one side.

checks_actually_performed.method: Checked that each reviewed JSON notes string appears verbatim in the generated notes file.
checks_actually_performed.result: No missing reviewed note was found.

checks_actually_performed.method: Compared the three classification decisions with the corresponding reviewed events and event-register rows.
checks_actually_performed.result: The two finite arithmetic/counting checks are classified as computation or formal certificate; the written-label and arrow-endpoint transcription comparison is classified as background. All three decisions are applied consistently.

checks_actually_performed.method: Inspected event outcomes, supporting reviewed notes, original reader-report notes and event records, and the saved scan071 quotient-check record for correspondence between each non-background claim and documented work. Inspected the explicit conditional arguments recorded for scan073 and their recorded rechecks. Original and reviewed statement-ID remapping was taken into account.
checks_actually_performed.result: Each computation, targeted proof check, and used-and-rechecked label had corresponding recorded calculations, enumerations, conditional arguments, or rechecks. The limits of those checks were stated; no claim was found to extend its recorded work to an unverified geometric or moduli theorem.

checks_actually_performed.method: Read the background and non-background event descriptions with their notes, distinguishing a manuscript assertion or transcription check from recorded mathematical work.
checks_actually_performed.result: No manuscript-only assertion was found inflated into an unsupported computation, proof, or recheck claim.

checks_actually_performed.check: Arithmetic-slip notes versus current page text
checks_actually_performed.method: Compared notes about possible source arithmetic or sign slips with the current TeX source text for scans054,062,063,064,065,071,073,074. This was a comparison of existing text and existing recorded calculations; no new mathematical calculation was performed.
checks_actually_performed.result: No contradiction was found. Notes preserve the relevant source readings and explicitly retain unresolved denominator or sign alternatives where present; conditional expected values are distinguished from the current manuscript transcription.

result.conclusion: The event register, reviewed records, generated notes, classification decisions, and inspected current page text are documentarily consistent. The non-background labels have corresponding recorded work, and the arithmetic-slip notes agree with the current page text.

limitations: This review assesses the consistency and scope of the existing documentation; it does not independently establish the mathematical truth of the manuscript or reperform the recorded checks.
The review does not provide independent execution provenance beyond the existing written records and the supplemental work file inspected.
No manuscript image rereading, external research, OCR, new proof, new mathematical computation, or TeX compilation/rendering was performed for this review.
